description: This file contains an extension to the NodeAppModel class with methods related to resolving URLs for Canvas hosts and A2 UI, normalization of URLs, and network probing functionality specific to iOS platform integrations.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURL
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves and constructs the URL for the Canvas host, considering if it is a loopback host.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURL
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the URL for the A2 UI host, appending specific path components.

methods.name: normalizeURLForTrustComparison
methods.description: Static method that normalizes a URL string by lowercasing scheme/host and removing fragments for trust comparisons.

methods.name: showA2UIOnConnectIfNeeded
methods.description: Displays the default A2 UI canvas upon connection, resetting the last auto URL.

methods.name: ensureA2UIReadyWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Ensures the A2 UI is ready with capability refresh, returning a status enum.

methods.name: showLocalCanvasOnDisconnect
methods.description: Shows the default local canvas upon disconnection.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Resolves the A2 UI URL, refreshing node canvas capability if needed.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Resolves the Canvas host URL, refreshing node canvas capability if needed.

methods.name: probeTCP
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous TCP probe to the provided URL with a timeout, primarily for network preflight checks.
